beats.text: Window seat. Hyderabad to Vizag. 12 hours with a stranger.
She wrote in a notebook the whole way. He pretended not to look.
Rajahmundry. The bridge. She tore out a page and handed it to him.
It was a sketch of him, asleep. Under it: "You snore. Nice to meet you."
Vizag. She got off. He still has the page. Eleven years now.
beats.small: Some people stay for one journey. Some stay forever.

end.text: Ever met someone on a train you never forgot?
